messages:
maria (ML): Heads-up — q4b-int4 bring-up looks good on short prompts but failing on our longform summarization holdouts. saw spikes in ROUGE drop and hallucination rate on the 8k+ tokens group :worried:
aj: Can you paste the failing example(s)? curious if it's tokenization or kv cache eviction pattern
maria (ML): example (sanitized):
```
input: <LONG_ARTICLE_6k_tokens>
expected: concise factual summary
model_out: adds unrelated events + invents dates
```
Also noticed top-1 beam diversity ends abruptly at ~4k tokens.
sam: Interesting — did we enable the new kv-merge patch in the runtime for int4? that patch changed the cache spill threshold.
maria (ML): yes, runtime change went in on the canary yesterday. config: `kv_merge=true, spill_threshold=0.6`
dina: tagging the curation folks — we should expand the golden set with long-context anchors. current golden has < 200 long summaries, needs more edge cases. @lucas can you take labeler backlog triage? :pray:
lucas: I can. quick plan: (1) add 500 long-form items to golden candidate queue, (2) run dedupe with fuzzyhash threshold 0.72, (3) prioritize domain-diverse sources.
labeler-bot: added 500 tasks to `labeler-queue/longform-golden` (ETA 3d) :robot_face:
aj: For de-dup: prefer token-level overlap + semantic embed similarity. propose pipeline: filter by shingle Jaccard >0.6 OR embed cosine >0.92, then manual spotcheck 1%.
maria (ML): agree. also need a lightweight canary harness to run q4b-int4 vs q8 baseline on new golden candidates. small script: `./canary_run.sh --models q4b-int4,q8 --prompts longform_golden.csv --metrics rouge,precision,hallucination_rate`
sam: I'll wire the canary. ETA today to start runs. want to see per-prompt diffs and where hallucination_score >0.2
dina: labeling ops note — labelers should have a short rubric: 1) factual completeness, 2) hallucinated assertions flagged, 3) missing citations. keep each item 2 passes. will upload rubric to the queue.
lucas: snag — some of the 500 candidates are near-duplicates with existing golden entries (old seedbank). I'll run a dedupe sweep and then push the de-duplicated 350 to the labeler queue
maria (ML): thanks. once we have labels, schedule a regression alert for models: if q4b-int4 delta_rouge < -0.05 or hallucination_rate delta > +0.03, rollback to q8 canary until patched.
aj: one more thought — the runtime kv-merge change might be the main culprit. can we test q4b-int4 with kv_merge=false for a small subset?
sam: yep. can run A/B: same model weights, different runtime flags. will include that in the canary matrix.
dina: also request a short prompt augmentation — include 3 synthetic prompts that stress multi-hop facts so we catch hallucination patterns earlier.
maria (ML): put link to tracking doc: https://redwood.company/s/ops/q4b-long-summ-bringup (private) — add notes on rollback policy and owner.
lucas: timeline: dedupe + queue prep today, labeler-bot kicks off tomorrow, canary runs start tomorrow PM, initial results Thu morning.
aj: ping me if canary shows clear divergence; I can revert the kv patch on the canary pool for quick comparison.
maria (ML): perfect. thanks all — let's aim to ship a golden refresh + runtime patch or rollback by end of week. :thumbsup:
